description.value: The Rose and Crown bills itself as Tsawwassen's only neighbourhood pub, a lively sports bar with 12 large-screen TVs, a games room with pool table and dartboard, and a separate quieter lounge called Metro's Lounge for a more relaxed visit. The kitchen runs seven days a week with a full pub menu and a weekend brunch, while the pub calendar includes live music nights, themed DJ nights, monthly karaoke, and a last-Wednesday trivia night. It is a well-established local institution — the head chef has been on staff for over 23 years — and a natural stop for cyclists passing through the Tsawwassen ferry and border corridor.
